description:
PROPOSED s493 (Fable, angle 1 of the new ways of running tests; ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s493/angles/WRITEUP.md "What I would make permanent" item 2), SCHEDULED by the USER in s494 (AskUserQuestion, 2026-09-21: "Core-module companion leg" selected).

WHAT WAS MEASURED (s493, scratch runner ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s493/bin/modtests.pl, log ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s493/angles/modtests-sample1.log): a ten-dist sample = 74 files perl can run, 30 fully matching under pcl, rows perl ok 1,756 / pcl ok 1,201 = 68.4 % (the perl-tests sweep: 96.5 %).  Per dist: Getopt::Long 100 %, Text::Balanced 88, File::Temp 25, Carp 15, Text::Tabs 10, Time::Local 0 (`subtest`).  The module surface is where ordinary scripts fail (#1994), and this population is somebody else's assertions about exactly that surface.

THE SHAPE (design sketch; an Opus agent executes it from a brief Fable writes):
1. `tools/run-perl-suite.pl` already has the oracle run, the row baselines (`baselines/perl-suite-fails.tsv` form), the timeout registry, NOT-RUN rows, the CAUSE column and the serial re-run of movers.  What is missing is a second ROOT: `<perl source>/{cpan,dist}/<Dist>/t/*.t` (+ `lib/*.t` later), run with cwd = the DIST directory and `-Ilib -It/lib`.  The source tree is found through `tools/lib/PCLPaths.pm` (a new resolver beside `perl_suite_t`; never a written-down path -- guard `Pl/t/no-hardcoded-paths-01.t`).  When the tree is absent the leg plan-skips LOUDLY (CI has no perl source tree).
2. Population, first round: the ~40 dists an ordinary script uses (pure-Perl only; an XS dist is NOT-RUN with its reason).  The list is a checked-in tsv (dist<TAB>why), not a glob, so the population is countable and a dist enters by EDIT.
3. Its OWN baselines, separate files from the t/ companion's (`baselines/core-modules-run.tsv` + `-fails.tsv`), blessed ONCE from a quiet-box run after a per-dist read; after that rows leave BY EDIT with a cause, like every other baseline.
4. ON DEMAND, like the companion: NOT in the Pl/t gate, NOT in CI.  WHAT-TO-RUN-WHEN's `lib/**` shim row changes from "the files that `use` the module" to "the module's own t/ (this leg) + the files that use it".
5. rule 9a: the dist list lives in `baselines/` or `tools/`, never in `Pl/` or `cl/`.

BAR: `tools/t/` guard for the second root (a fixture dist with two rows, like tools/t/perl-suite-causes.t); the first blessed run's per-dist table in the task; a TIMEOUT or a crash-form is a NOT-RUN/PARTIAL row, never an absence (#176).

PRIORITY: scheduled, behind the two in-flight everyday batches (s492b, s492c).  s492c uses the scratch runner as its acceptance instrument; this task makes that instrument permanent AFTER s492c merges (so the first bless measures the merged tree, not a moving one).


BRIEF (s494): ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s494/s494m/prompt.md (label s494m, IDs 2230-2259, no gen string; launch AFTER s492c is merged).  NOT launched in s494: the USER said mid-session "don`t start new subjobs in this session".
